item.title: Amakusa Islands — Guide
item.description: The Amakusa Islands, a beautiful chain of over a hundred islands off the west coast of Kumamoto, combine gorgeous coastal scenery with fascinating history and abundant wildlife. Connected to the mainland and each other by a series of bridges (the ‘Amakusa Five Bridges’) and ferries, they are one of the best places in Japan for wild dolphin watching, with resident pods of bottlenose dolphins seen year-round on boat tours. Amakusa also has a poignant Christian history: it was a stronghold of persecuted ‘hidden Christians’ and the centre of the 1637 Shimabara-Amakusa Rebellion, and its churches and related sites form part of a UNESCO World Heritage listing.
